fusions.name: Bill Clamp
fusions.desc: Clamps onto a target, dealing 12 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Even Touch
fusions.desc: Dabs a bead of water that deals 7 damage, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been wounded. It holds 4 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Lead the Way
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 9 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Sure Strokes
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%. Your abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
